After Mahmud I, his son Jalal al-Dawla Nasr (Nasr II) took throne in 1075, followed by another son, Sabiq ibn Mahmud (Sabiq), in 1076. This pattern shows importance of lineage and kinship in securing power and continue rule of Mirdasid dynasty in Aleppo.
